_doc: Outreach control as data. Edit by PR; the owner flips kill or mode. kill=true stops every stage that contacts anyone, at once. mode=dry-run writes packets, queues and logs but contacts nobody. mode=live additionally delivers email-route targets through the sender adapter, and only when sender.registered is true and the OUTREACH_SEND_URL and OUTREACH_SEND_TOKEN secrets exist. Form routes are never submitted by an agent: they become one consolidated owner card per profile. Rate limits are hard caps. The intro lane (outreach_intro.py) shares this gate and its caps; it additionally needs sender.postal_address before any live send, and sender.booking_url (https) is an optional calendar link added to the message.

sender.note: Owner card OUT-SENDER: register a sending identity (domain mailbox) once; until then nothing is delivered.
